column3: ## Upload a file where some articles are valid and some are not

Setup: Use the publisher_with_journal testdrive to set up for this test at /testdrive/publisher_with_journal. It creates a publisher account owning a journal in DOAJ with Print ISSN "1111-1111" and E-ISSN "2222-2222"
Setup: If you have run this testdrive before, use the 'teardown' link from that earlier run first, so that no other journal has these ISSNs
Setup: Keep the testdrive tab open (closing it removes the test data) and do the test in a separate tab
Setup: At the end of the test please use the 'teardown' link provided by the testdrive to remove test assets from the system
Log in as the publisher account specified by the testdrive result

Go to the "Upload Article XML" tab in the "Publisher Area"

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//publisher/uploadfile
Choose "DOAJ Native XML" from "Format of the file" dropdown

Select "Choose file" and select the test resource file "mixed_valid_and_invalid.xml" from the DOAJ folder.  It contains one valid article and one article with the unknown ISSN "5555-5555"

Test Resource: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DOAJ/doaj/feature/4343_no_info_article_api/doajtest/xml_upload_test_package/DOAJ/mixed_valid_and_invalid.xml

column4: A flash message appears at the top of the screen indicating a successful upload: File uploaded and waiting to be processed. Check back here for updates. (Dismiss)
Click away to another tab and then back - your file is shown in the "History of uploads" with the status "pending"

column3: wait a short amount of time for the job to process, then click away and then back.  If the job remains in "pending", reload the page until the status changes.

column4: Your file is shown in the "History of uploads" with the status "processing failed", NOT "partial success"
The "Notes" show "One or more articles failed to ingest; entire batch ingest halted" and "Valid articles not imported: 1. Failed articles: 1."

column3: click on "(show error details)" for the record in the "History of uploads"

column4: Additional error details are shown, indicating that the ISSN "5555-5555" does not appear in DOAJ.

column3: Go to the Table of Contents for the journal (e.g. by going to /toc/2222-2222)

column4: There is no article with the title "A valid article in a file with an invalid article", because no articles in the file are imported when any of them fail
